profile.overview: Witch / Growth is Vox Mana's four-color without Red expression for patient cultivation, calculated expansion, protected accumulation, and ambition disciplined into long-horizon growth.
profile.philosophy: Witch believes the future should be cultivated before it is claimed: Green grows the root, White protects the trellis, Blue measures the method, and Black keeps ambition aimed at inevitability without letting Red-style impulse take command.
profile.core_tension: Witch cultivates protected growth through structure, calculation, and ambition, but patient planning can become sterile control when Red-style impulse is excluded too completely.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Counters, proliferate texture, protected engines, value accumulation, and scaling board development can express Witch's patient accumulation only when they serve the full missing-Red protected-growth worldview; mechanics alone do not define the identity.
